d: A centaur with the upper body of a youthful adolescent and the lower body of a deer. Long, wavy chestnut brown hair falls in a thick braid over one shoulder, adorned with small white flowers, while long deer ears sprout from the head. The face is youthful and serene with narrow, olive green eyes. The upper body wears a white, long-sleeved collared dress with a high waist, secured by a dark brown leather belt and matching leather straps around the upper arm. The lower body is a brown deer's form, featuring white dappled spots on the haunches and white frost-like markings on the lower legs. BODY COLOR: Brown
